newsitem.title: USA: Besicorp in pact with Niagra and 16 plants.
newsitem.headline: Besicorp in pact with Niagra and 16 plants.

text.p: Besicorp Group Inc said Thursday it entered into a restructuring agreement with Niagara Mohawk Power Corp and 16 independent power plants.
Besicorp said the pact calls for the termination or restructuring of 29 independent power contracts.

Besicorp said it has stakes ranging from 36 percent to 50 percent in five projects that have contracts with Niagara in partnership with affiliates of Kamine Development Corp of Bedminster, N.J. The projects have a capacity of 323 megawatts, the company added.

The company said the closing of the deal is dependent on final negotiations between Niagara and the plants' owners; approval by Niagara shareholders and the New York Public Service Commission and other regulators; Niagara's financing; and new independent power plant third-party arrangements.
Besicorp's stock traded at 20-3/4 Thursday afternoon, up 7/8.
